name: mentra-ai-local
description: Mentra AI as a local (on-phone) MentraOS miniapp. Voice assistant with wake-word, vision, and web search, backed by a small server that holds the AI secrets.

scripts.dev:local: MENTRA_AI_PORT=${MENTRA_AI_PORT:-3131}; NGROK_DOMAIN=${NGROK_DOMAIN:-general.dev.tpa.ngrok.app}; MENTRA_PUBLIC_MENTRA_AI_BACKEND_URL=${MENTRA_PUBLIC_MENTRA_AI_BACKEND_URL:-https://$NGROK_DOMAIN}; pids=""; cleanup() { echo "\n[dev] shutting down (ngrok + backend + miniapp)"; kill $pids 2>/dev/null; }; trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM; ngrok http --domain=$NGROK_DOMAIN $MENTRA_AI_PORT --log=stdout > /dev/null & pids="$pids $!"; PORT=$MENTRA_AI_PORT bun run backend:dev:local & pids="$pids $!"; MENTRA_PUBLIC_MENTRA_AI_BACKEND_URL=$MENTRA_PUBLIC_MENTRA_AI_BACKEND_URL bun run miniapp:dev & pids="$pids $!"; wait
scripts.dev:doppler: doppler run --project mentra-ai --config dev --preserve-env -- sh -c 'MENTRA_AI_PORT=${MENTRA_AI_PORT:-3131}; NGROK_DOMAIN=${NGROK_DOMAIN:-general.dev.tpa.ngrok.app}; MENTRA_PUBLIC_MENTRA_AI_BACKEND_URL=${MENTRA_PUBLIC_MENTRA_AI_BACKEND_URL:-https://$NGROK_DOMAIN}; pids=""; cleanup() { echo "\n[dev] shutting down (ngrok + backend + miniapp)"; kill $pids 2>/dev/null; }; trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM; ngrok http --domain=$NGROK_DOMAIN $MENTRA_AI_PORT --log=stdout > /dev/null & pids="$pids $!"; PORT=$MENTRA_AI_PORT bun run backend:dev:local & pids="$pids $!"; MENTRA_PUBLIC_MENTRA_AI_BACKEND_URL=$MENTRA_PUBLIC_MENTRA_AI_BACKEND_URL bun run miniapp:dev & pids="$pids $!"; wait'
scripts.dev:localhost: doppler run --project mentra-ai --config dev --preserve-env -- sh -c 'MENTRA_AI_PORT=${MENTRA_AI_PORT:-3131}; MENTRA_PUBLIC_MENTRA_AI_BACKEND_URL=${MENTRA_PUBLIC_MENTRA_AI_BACKEND_URL:-http://localhost:3131}; pids=""; cleanup() { kill $pids 2>/dev/null; }; trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM; PORT=$MENTRA_AI_PORT bun run backend:dev:local & pids="$pids $!"; MENTRA_PUBLIC_MENTRA_AI_BACKEND_URL=$MENTRA_PUBLIC_MENTRA_AI_BACKEND_URL bun run miniapp:dev & pids="$pids $!"; wait'
scripts.backend:dev:doppler: doppler run --project mentra-ai --config dev --preserve-env -- sh -c 'PORT=${MENTRA_AI_PORT:-3131} bun run backend:dev:local'
